title: On the Langlands--Kottwitz--Scholze method
summary: Using recent advances in the integral canonical models of Shimura varieties using syntomic methods, we give an extension of the Langlands--Kottwitz--Scholze method from Scholze's paper on the Langlands--Kottwitz method for deformation spaces of $p$-divisible groups. Namely, we define analogues $φ^{\mathcal{G},μ}_{τ,h}$ of the local test functions from op. cit. in full generality, show they satisfy reasonable harmonic-analytic properties, and give rise to trace formulae for the Galois-Hecke action on the cohomology of Shimura varieties of bad reduction.
